title: Dolly Zoom In
description: A dolly zoom in approaches on wheels while the lens zooms out, so the figure holds or grows as the background warps inward. Counter-zoom is the point: size and space disagree.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Approach that makes the world sick. The person stays large or grows while the room or street stretches and recedes.
Vertigo as getting closer. A plain push-in keeps perspective honest.
A plain zoom-out shrinks the person. The compound is the disagreement.
If either half is missing, you do not have the warp.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Dolly in along the lens axis while zooming toward a wider focal length, timed so subject size holds or grows. Background perspective opens (more wide-angle) as you near, which reads as the world warping inward or falling away.
Prompt: Dolly zoom in on [Subject], counter-zoom so the figure grows while the background warps inward, vertigo as approach.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for a realization that arrives as nausea while you approach. Do not use it on a walk that only needs a dolly.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Dolly Zoom is the parent compound. Push In translates without the opposite zoom.
Dolly Zoom Out reverses the pair: retreat while zooming in, space yawning the other way.
Dolly ZoomA realization that the ground is not stable. Use once.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Jaws uses the beach shock as an approach that makes the world recede around a still-large face. Vertigo names the warp.
Goodfellas uses a diner compound as the ground dropping under a thought. Grammar: size and space at odds.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a push-in or a zoom. The tell: the person grows and the background grows with them, or the person shrinks.
The fix: dolly in plus zoom out, subject size held or growing, background perspective warping.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Dolly Zoom In in film?
A dolly zoom in dollies toward the subject while zooming out, so the figure holds or grows as the background warps. Size and space disagree.
Dolly Zoom In vs Push In
A push-in approaches with honest perspective. Dolly zoom in adds an opposite zoom so the world warps while the person stays large or grows.
When should I use Dolly Zoom In?
Use it for an approach that should feel sick: a realization, a threat arriving. Do not use it as default coverage.
How do I prompt Dolly Zoom In for AI image or video?
Write dolly in plus zoom out. Example: Dolly zoom in on [Subject], counter-zoom so the figure grows while the background warps inward.
